unit_label: BRBL B U06: Securities and modes of charge II — Distinguish non-possessory hypothecation from pledge and design controls for goods remaining with the borrower

facts.locator: printed pp. 206–208; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware describes borrower-held movable stock, fraud/substitution risks, inspection, statements, insurance and covenants. Its contradictory bank-ownership wording is held back.

facts.locator: section 2(1)(n), official PDF p. 7; section 31(a)–(b), p. 34; selected web-inspection notes retained
facts.statement: Hypothecation is the defined charge on existing or future movables without delivery of possession, including floating-charge crystallisation. The Act expressly excludes the specified liens and section 172 movable pledges; a security label alone does not establish a SARFAESI enforcement right.

payload.title: Borrower possession changes the control problem
payload.core_explanation_md:
Hypothecation charges movable property while possession remains undelivered to the secured creditor. The borrower may need the goods for production or daily trade, so ongoing stock integrity becomes a central credit-control issue. Do not rewrite a charge as the bank becoming the absolute owner of every item, or describe a borrower-held arrangement as a proved pledge without examining delivery.

The statutory definition includes existing and future movables and the stated floating-charge features. Those words describe the security form; they do not establish every condition for enforcement. SARFAESI also has express exclusions, including the specified lien and movable-pledge categories. The remedy needs its own applicability analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: What central possession distinction separates the described hypothecation from a pledge enquiry?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The hypothecation definition involves no delivery of possession to the secured creditor; pledge depends on bailment for security.

payload.title: Treat stock reporting as a claim to verify
payload.core_explanation_md:
Where goods stay with the borrower, a monthly stock statement is information rather than proof that all listed goods exist, remain valuable and are free of other claims. Compare statements with inspections, records, permitted stock movements, title and charge searches, insurance and the agreed controls. A signboard is a notice aid, not a substitute for these enquiries.

The courseware highlights obsolete stock, substitution, disposal and multiple financing as risks. Build the review around the identified risk: for example, investigate stock-age deterioration even if total reported value is unchanged. Covenants on disclosure, further charges, insurance and inspection should be read with the actual agreement and applicable law. No generic clause by itself establishes current priority or permits immediate possession-taking.

self_check.prompt_text: Why can an unchanged total stock value still need investigation?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The quantity, quality, age, title and composition may have changed even when the reported total is unchanged.

payload.stem_md: A hypothecation report states that ownership of all borrower stock automatically vests absolutely in the bank simply because the charge exists. Which correction follows the inspected definition?

options.text_md: Hypothecation is always a completed physical delivery of goods to the bank
options.explanation_md: The definition expressly describes creation without delivery of possession.

options.text_md: The charge removes the need to investigate borrower title
options.explanation_md: Security creation does not make the underlying title enquiry redundant.

options.text_md: Describe the defined non-possessory charge and examine title and remedies separately
options.explanation_md: The definition establishes a security form, not that blanket absolute-ownership conclusion.

options.text_md: Borrower possession means no charge can ever exist
options.explanation_md: Non-delivery of possession is part of the statutory hypothecation definition.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The definition establishes a security form, not that blanket absolute-ownership conclusion.

payload.stem_md: Reported hypothecated stock value is stable, but inspection finds that saleable goods have been replaced by slow-moving goods. Which response addresses the courseware risk?

options.text_md: Reassess quality, realisable value, reporting and covenant compliance despite the unchanged total
options.explanation_md: Substitution and obsolescence can erode security while the headline reported value remains unchanged.

options.text_md: Accept the reported total as conclusive proof of unchanged collateral quality
options.explanation_md: The unchanged aggregate does not establish the composition or recoverable value.

options.text_md: Treat the site signboard as a replacement for stock and title verification
options.explanation_md: A notice sign does not prove stock existence, condition or ownership.

options.text_md: Assume all enforcement prerequisites are satisfied by the stock statement alone
options.explanation_md: A report cannot establish every statutory and contractual enforcement condition.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Substitution and obsolescence can erode security while the headline reported value remains unchanged.
